summaries.title: Scaling Instructable Agents Across Many Simulated Worlds
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**智能体与代码工程**（Agents & SWE）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **Scaling Instructable Agents Across Many** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖智能体与代码工程（Agents & SWE），并引入 Multiworld Agent (SIMA) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：In this paper we describe our motivation and goal, the initial progress we have made, and promising preliminary results on several diverse research environments and a variety...。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：Our goal is to develop an instructable agent that can accomplish anything a human can do in any simulated 3D environment。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（In this paper we describe our motivation and goal, the initial progress we have made, and promising preliminary results on several diverse research environments and a variety of...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 28 赞），本工作为突破 **智能体与代码工程** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。

summaries.title: Long-form music generation with latent diffusion
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**多模态与统一基座**（Multimodal）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **Long-form music generation with latent** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖多模态与统一基座（Multimodal）。核心论点主张：We show that by training a generative model on long temporal contexts it is possible to produce long-form music of up to 4m45s。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用迭代去噪生成/流匹配建模。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：Our model consists of a diffusion-transformer operating on a highly downsampled continuous latent representation (latent rate of 21.5Hz)。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（We show that by training a generative model on long temporal contexts it is possible to produce long-form music of...；It obtains state-of-the-art generations according to metrics on audio quality and prompt alignment, and subjective...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 27 赞），本工作为突破 **多模态与统一基座** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。
